notes: All returns are nominal, annualized compound (geometric) returns over a 10-15 year horizon. The model converts them to real (inflation-adjusted) returns, so every dollar figure the planner shows is in today's dollars.

jpm_2026.label: Base case: J.P. Morgan 2026 LTCMA
sources: J.P. Morgan Asset Management, 2026 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions (data as of 2025-09-30): U.S. large cap 6.7%, U.S. aggregate bonds 4.8%, U.S. inflation 2.5%.
Volatility: Vanguard Capital Markets Model (2025-03-31 run): U.S. equities 16.4%, U.S. aggregate bonds 6.4% median volatility.
Stock-bond correlation of 0.10 is a project assumption; it is a user-adjustable input.

vanguard_2026.label: Conservative: Vanguard VCMM
sources: Vanguard Capital Markets Model (2026-06-30 run): U.S. equities 4.2%-6.2% 10-year annualized; midpoint 5.2% used.
Vanguard 2026 Economic and Market Outlook: U.S. bonds 3.8%-4.8% 10-year annualized; midpoint 4.3% used.
Inflation held at 2.5% so the two cases differ only in expected returns.

diy_index.label: DIY index funds
diy_index.source: Broad-market index fund expense ratio of about 0.05%.

robo.label: Robo-advisor
robo.source: Typical digital-advice fee of 0.25% plus ETF expense ratios of about 0.10%.

traditional.label: Traditional advisor (all-in)
traditional.source: Kitces Research 2024: median AUM fee of 1.00% on portfolios up to $1M. Inside Information (Bob Veres) via Kitces: all-in cost including underlying funds averages about 1.65%.
